# RikkaHub native UI snapshot

- Upstream: https://github.com/rikkahub/rikkahub
- Revision: `de4f157910c8e2ff22aabc3ae9c03a29c96edc53`
- Snapshot date: 2026-07-16
- Scope: Native Android UI sources, Android resources, the local Material 3 helper module, AI UI message models, and build metadata required to understand upstream dependencies.
- Excluded: RikkaHub web-ui and backend/service/database implementations.

This directory is a read-only upstream reference. Fcode-specific ports and modifications belong under `app/src/main/java/com/termux/app/` so upstream provenance remains reviewable.

RikkaHub uses the segmented dual-license text in `LICENSE`. Confirm commercial/public-distribution rights with the upstream maintainer before publishing an app derived from these sources.
